# Recipe Sharing App - MERN Stack with JWT Authentication

This project is a comprehensive recipe sharing application built with the MERN stack (MongoDB, Express.js, React.js, Node.js) featuring JWT authentication, recipe management, and social interactions.

## Features

- JWT-based user authentication (login/signup)
- Recipe CRUD operations with photo uploads
- Social features (like, comment, share)
- Search and filter functionality
- Responsive UI with Tailwind CSS
- File uploads with Multer
- MongoDB data storage with Mongoose

## Tech Stack

- Backend: Node.js, Express.js, MongoDB, Mongoose, JWT, Multer
- Frontend: React.js, React Router, Tailwind CSS
- Authentication: JSON Web Tokens
- File Storage: Multer (local) with Cloudinary option

## Project Structure

- `/backend` - Express.js API server
- `/frontend` - React.js client application

## Development Guidelines

- Use modern ES6+ JavaScript
- Implement proper error handling
- Follow RESTful API conventions
- Use responsive design principles
- Implement proper authentication middleware
